data.title: Hostel Facilities
data.description: Separate air-conditioned and non-air-conditioned hostels for boys and girls with 24/7 security, high-speed Wi-Fi, biometric entry, study rooms, gym, and hygienic multi-cuisine dining serving North and South Indian food.

data.title: Central Library
data.description: Spacious multi-storey library with over 50,000 books, international research journals, IEEE/ScienceDirect e-resources, multimedia kiosks, and quiet study zones.

data.title: Sports and Athletics
data.description: Comprehensive sports complex with cricket ground, football turf, basketball courts, volleyball, badminton courts, indoor sports hall, and certified coaches.

data.title: Transport Network
data.description: Fleet of air-conditioned and regular buses connecting all major hubs in Tiruchirappalli, Thanjavur, Samayapuram, Musiri, and Karur.
